name: Asana MCP
tagline: Manage Asana projects, tasks, and timelines from chat.
shortDescription: The Asana MCP server. Create and update tasks, manage projects, assign work, set due dates, and view portfolios. The canonical way to give an agent access to your team's work.
longDescription:
## What it is

The official Asana MCP server. Exposes the Asana API as MCP tools: create/update/complete tasks, manage projects and sections, assign work, set due dates, add followers, and view portfolios.

## Why we recommend it

If your team plans work in Asana, this is the cleanest way to let an agent help. The agent can turn chat into tasks, organize a project by section, and report status — without anyone opening Asana.

## When to use it

- Status reports: agent pulls 'what's done / in progress / blocked' for standups
- Task creation: agent turns a chat conversation into a well-formed task
- Workload: agent lists tasks by assignee to find who's overloaded
- Project hygiene: agent closes stale tasks, archives done projects
installInstructions:
1. Get a personal access token at https://app.asana.com/0/my-apps
2. Set `ASANA_TOKEN=...`
3. `npx -y @asana/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Asana has a generous free tier (up to 10 users).
